mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 5%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling weakening supply chains, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with 2mo consecutive INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a high RSAFS (above $400B) indicates strong demand for housing, a leading indicator for overall economic demand, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising FEDFUNDS and a high CPIAUCSL (above 240) creates inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances with rising FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS is above 138M, the strong labor market boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month average HOUST above 900K, indicating a strong housing market, always leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
